$comment: Chat attachment type labels: the ONE table both spellings of the rule are checked against. backend/tests/test_agent_generated_files.py feeds it to _attachment_type_label (backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, the label a persisted chat attachment carries); frontend/src/pages/chat/attachments.test.ts feeds it to fileTypeLabel (frontend/src/pages/chat/attachments.ts, the label the bubble shows until the conversation is refetched). A case that passes on one side only is a file that changes shape when the turn ends. Add a case here, never on one side only.

cases.name: a screenshot pasted in a browser is named image.png
an extensionless screenshot takes the MIME subtype
a structured-syntax suffix is stripped, so an SVG previews as a picture
a vendor subtype surfaces its last segment
a trailing dot falls through to the MIME subtype
a dotfile's name reads as its extension
octet-stream says nothing about the file
an empty content type (a browser that could not tell)
